name: all accounts combined: a day one account does not state is not a combined day, and the next combined day's return measures every account over the whole interval
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series (All accounts combined); Yearly return; Max drawdown
working: both accounts begin on 2025-12-31 and state through 2026-01-07 (today), so both count on every day from 12-31 to 01-07

combined days: a day counts once every account that has begun and not ended states a value for it: 12-31 (both), 01-02 (both), 01-06 (both), 01-07 (both); 01-05 is not a combined day, since B states nothing for it though A does
net deposits stay 1000 for each account on every stated day, so every flow is 0

pre-history floor: combined balances 2000, 2000, 2110, 1688; all-time peak 2110 (A's own highest 1210, B's 1000, so no reading of the peak exceeds 2210), 1 % ≤ 22.10; every balance clears it, so nothing is cut and 2026 is measured from 1 January over 2025-12-31 (the last stated day before it)
benchmark: flat closes of 100, so 0 over the same span

name: all accounts combined: an account whose statements stop leaves the series from its last stated day, and the series continues on the others
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series (All accounts combined); Yearly return; Max drawdown
working: A states 2025-12-31 through 2026-01-06 (today); B states 2025-12-31 and 2026-01-02 only: B's last stated day is 01-02, so it counts from 12-31 to 01-02 and not after
combined days: 12-31 (both), 01-02 (both), 01-05 (A alone: B has ended), 01-06 (A alone); B's ending does not end the series
net deposits stay 1000 for each account on every stated day, so every flow is 0

pre-history floor: combined balances 2000, 1900, 1210, 1331; all-time peak 2000, 1 % = 20; every balance clears it (B leaving the combined balance at 1210 is far above 20), so nothing is cut and 2026 is measured from 1 January over 2025-12-31
01-05 (from 01-02): only A states both days: 1210 ÷ 1100 − 1 = 0.1; B's leaving is not a loss (the combined balance falling 1900 → 1210 is not read as a return)
benchmark: flat closes of 100, so 0 over the same span

name: all accounts combined: each account's return is net of the money moved into it over the interval, and the returns are weighted by the accounts' values on the earlier day
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series (All accounts combined; weighted by beginning values, GIPS 2010 I.2.A.6); Yearly return; Max drawdown
working: both accounts state 2025-12-31, 2026-01-02 and 2026-01-06 (today); A also states 01-05, B does not, so 01-05 is not a combined day
combined days: 12-31, 01-02, 01-06
pre-history floor: combined balances 4000, 4000, 4350; all-time peak 4350, 1 % = 43.50; every balance clears it, so nothing is cut and 2026 is measured from 1 January over 2025-12-31

weighted by values on 01-02 (A 1000, B 3000): (1000 × 0.15 + 3000 × −0.1) ÷ 4000 = (150 − 300) ÷ 4000 = −0.0375 (an equal weighting would give 0.025; the deposit read as a gain would give (1650 + 2700) ÷ 4000 − 1 = 0.0875)
flow-adjusted index 1, 1, 0.9625: peak 1, trough 0.9625 on 01-06, −0.0375
benchmark: flat closes of 100, so 0 over the same span
